description: Pattern 'if let Some(x) = patch.field { if !x.is_empty() { ... } }' appears ~12 times in space.rs (lines 270, 291, 299, 327, 353, 361, 400, 424, 432, 462, 486, 494) and chat.rs (lines 320, 336, 344). MSRV is 1.88 — let-chains stabilized in 1.88. Idiomatic form: 'if let Some(x) = patch.field && !x.is_empty() { ... }'. Reduces indentation by one level and reads as the single conjoined condition it is. Engineering basis: lower indentation depth, fewer braces to track, expresses the actual control-flow intent (a single conjunction) rather than two nested guards. message.rs:190-201 has a triply-nested 'if let Some(not_created) + if let Some(err) + if err.error_type == "rateLimited"' that benefits even more. Workspace let-chain adoption should be a workspace-wide sweep — file as workspace-level if confirmed elsewhere.
title: Nested 'if let Some + if !.is_empty()' should be let-chains under MSRV 1.88
